_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Tu si Jucaturi {player_id} ntô Trì-Jucatura Tic Tac Toe.
Lu tò simbulu è '{symbol}'.
Tu fai turni mettennu lu tò simbulu supra na tavuliera 5x5 pî formari na linia di quattru.
Li linii ponnu essiri orizzuntali, verticali, o diagonalî.
Prisenta lu tò mossu usannu lu formatu '[4]' pî marcare la cella 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Formatu di muvimentu non validu. Utilizzari "[cell]" unni la cellula è 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Nùmmuru di cella non validu: {cell}. Havi à essiri tra 0 e {max_cell}.
invalid_move.made_invalid: Lu jucaturi {player_id} fici na mossa nun valida.

game_action.placed: Jucaturi {player_id} metti lu sò simbulu ({symbol}) ntô campu ({row}, {col}).
